P_0x00D5BF: A Li Technologist, developer of the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige. Eccentric, rational. Close to Joshua and Lim, like a watchful brother.
P_0x00D6DD: Lead figure of the Li Technologists, excavating the Antarctic ruins. Joshua's father and Lim's adoptive father. He put research above family, often clashing with Joshua.
P_0x00D81A: A girl rescued on Commodin Island. Lost memories; identity unknown. Quiet, kind-hearted.
P_0x00D8D3: A powerful psychic called "Mashiaf," Priestess of Gan Eden. Her role: become Gan Eden's core, judge Earth defenders' will, guiding them to Baral. Not made by Gan Eden - chosen for aptitude, given Mashiaf's mission and power.
P_0x00DA9D: Captain of the Spacenoah carrier Kurogane. Once Colony Integ. Army, seconded to DC with Ratsel as exec officer. Stayed with Ratsel past the L5 Campaign, now commands the ship.
P_0x00DC00: Subordinate of Shu serving destroyer god Saerva Volkruss, known as "Crimson Saphine." On Shu's orders handles sabotage, espionage, disrupting foes. A beauty with perverse tastes.
